notice: Domain migration contract: the format of a project's gtt-domain that this Bootstrap expects, and what a migration may write. Data only. The scripts read it; they never infer it from README text.
never_write: an Epic's heading block (Goal, Scope, Out of Scope, Approved)
bump_when: a release changes what gtt-domain must contain in a way a validator or a script reads; a mechanical step for the change is added to the migration, the judgment is the agent's
